title: RESPA - kickbacks and settlement services
facts: RESPA prohibits certain kickbacks and referral fees for settlement-service business involving federally related mortgage loans.
A person generally may not give or accept a fee, kickback or thing of value under an agreement that settlement-service business will be referred, subject to statutory exceptions.
RESPA does not prohibit payment for actual services genuinely performed merely because parties in a real-estate transaction do business together.
Affiliated business arrangements have specific disclosure and other requirements.
